tools.name: post_sprint_summary_to_slack
tools.description: Posts a sprint summary message to a Slack channel through an incoming webhook. The message is sent to Slack and visible to everyone in that channel.

params.name: sprint_name
params.description: Name of the sprint being summarized

params.name: completed_points
params.description: Story points completed in the sprint

params.name: planned_points
params.description: Story points planned for the sprint

tools.code:
import os
import requests
from agents import function_tool

SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL = os.environ["SLACK_SPRINT_WEBHOOK_URL"]


@function_tool
def post_sprint_summary_to_slack(sprint_name: str, completed_points: int, planned_points: int, highlights: str) -> str:
    pct = round(100 * completed_points / planned_points) if planned_points else 0
    text = (
        f"*Sprint summary: {sprint_name}*\n"
        f"Completed {completed_points}/{planned_points} points ({pct}%)\n"
        f"{highlights}"
    )
    resp = requests.post(SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL, json={"text": text}, timeout=10)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return f"Posted summary for {sprint_name} to Slack (status {resp.status_code})"

tools.name: notify_assignee_of_overdue_task
tools.description: Sends an email to the assignee of a task reminding them that it is overdue, and posts a notification to the team's webhook endpoint. Both messages go outside the system.

params.name: extra_message
params.description: Optional note to include in the reminder

tools.code:
import os
import smtplib
import sqlite3
from email.message import EmailMessage

import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("project-tasks")

DB_PATH = os.environ.get("TASKS_DB", "tasks.db")
SMTP_HOST = os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", "localhost")
TEAM_WEBHOOK = os.environ["TEAM_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK"]


def _load_task(task_id):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT t.title, t.due_date, u.email, u.name "
            "FROM tasks t JOIN users u ON u.id = t.assignee_id WHERE t.id = ?",
            (task_id,),
        ).fetchone()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    if row is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Task {task_id} not found")
    return {"title": row[0], "due": row[1], "email": row[2], "name": row[3]}


@mcp.tool()
def notify_assignee_of_overdue_task(task_id: int, extra_message: str = "") -> str:
    task = _load_task(task_id)
    body = (
        f"Hi {task['name']},\n\n"
        f"Task #{task_id} '{task['title']}' was due on {task['due']} and is still open.\n"
    )
    if extra_message:
        body += f"\n{extra_message}\n"
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["Subject"] = f"Overdue: {task['title']}"
    msg["From"] = "tasks@example.com"
    msg["To"] = task["email"]
    msg.set_content(body)
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST) as server:
        server.send_message(msg)
    resp = requests.post(
        TEAM_WEBHOOK,
        json={"event": "task_overdue_reminder", "task_id": task_id, "assignee": task["email"]},
        timeout=10,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return f"Reminder emailed to {task['email']} and team webhook notified"

tools.name: delete_sprint_and_its_tasks
tools.description: Permanently deletes a sprint along with all tasks and comments that belong to it. This cannot be undone.

params.name: sprint_id
params.description: ID of the sprint to delete

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing

from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = os.environ.get("TASKS_DB", "tasks.db")


@tool
def delete_sprint_and_its_tasks(sprint_id: int) -> str:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)) as conn:
        with conn:
            exists = conn.execute(
                "SELECT 1 FROM sprints WHERE id = ?", (sprint_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if not exists:
                return f"Sprint {sprint_id} not found"
            conn.execute(
                "DELETE FROM comments WHERE task_id IN "
                "(SELECT id FROM tasks WHERE sprint_id = ?)",
                (sprint_id,),
            )
            cur = conn.execute(
                "DELETE FROM tasks WHERE sprint_id = ?", (sprint_id,)
            )
            n_tasks = cur.rowcount
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM sprints WHERE id = ?", (sprint_id,))
    return f"Deleted sprint {sprint_id} and {n_tasks} tasks"

tools.name: purge_stale_done_tasks
tools.description: Finds tasks marked done that were closed more than the given number of days ago, permanently deletes them, and returns the list of titles that were removed.

params.name: project_id
params.description: ID of the project to clean up

params.name: days
params.description: Minimum number of days since closing

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timedelta


def purge_stale_done_tasks(project_id: int, days: int) -> dict:
    db = os.environ.get("TASKS_DB", "tasks.db")
    cut = (datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(days=days)).isoformat()
    cn = sqlite3.connect(db)
    cur = cn.cursor()
    rows = cur.execute(
        "SELECT id, title FROM tasks WHERE project_id = ? "
        "AND status = 'done' AND closed_at < ?",
        (project_id, cut),
    ).fetchall()
    ids = [r[0] for r in rows]
    if not ids:
        cn.close()
        return {"deleted": 0, "titles": []}
    qs = ",".join("?" * len(ids))
    cur.execute(f"DELETE FROM comments WHERE task_id IN ({qs})", ids)
    cur.execute(f"DELETE FROM tasks WHERE id IN ({qs})", ids)
    n = cur.rowcount
    cn.commit()
    cn.close()
    return {"deleted": n, "titles": [r[1] for r in rows]}
